pages.text: Lay a solid $(thing)5 × 5$() floor. Add a one-block-high rim around its edge, leaving a $(thing)3 × 3$() basin. Put two more blocks on top of each corner of the rim. Leave the space above the water open.
Top views of the base and the layer just above it. Raise each marked corner by two blocks.

pages.title: Activate the Pool
pages.text: Use sandstone from the Forge sandstone tag or Atum limestone bricks. Ordinary sand is unsuitable. Fill the basin with water and drop a $(item)Scarab$() into it with your drop key. The water becomes a portal and the Scarab is consumed. Step into the pool to cross.

pages.title: If It Stays Water
pages.text: If nothing happens, check the solid floor, the whole rim, all four pillars, and that the dropped item is sitting in water. Servers can disable survival activation with $(thing)Atum Portal$() in the common config.

pages.title: Larger Portals
pages.text: An interior can be 3–9 blocks wide and 3–9 blocks long. The rim adds one block on each side. The smallest design uses 49 frame blocks. Start with the 5 × 5 plan so the water is easy to fill.
